units.source_text: 在日本棋院举办的春季升段赛上，大竹七段八盘全败。

en.t: At the spring promotion tournament held by the Nihon Ki-in, Otake, a seventh-dan player, lost all eight of his games.

units.source_text: 可是在选拔担任名人告别赛对手的新闻杯赛中，他却大获全胜。

en.t: But in the newspaper cup tournament held to choose the opponent for the Master's farewell match, he instead won overwhelmingly, taking every game.

units.source_text: 他的成绩很不稳定，真叫人吃惊。

en.t: His results were extremely inconsistent, which was truly astonishing.
